decisions.reason: As a burner component closely tied to the installed radiant-heater base, it strengthens the firm's core systems and service business at relatively low portfolio risk.
The electric infrared panel heater fits the firm's energy-efficient heating range and supports demand for lower-carbon, flexible solutions in non-residential spaces.
The electric halogen infrared heater extends the portfolio for fast-response spot or outdoor heating and matches the firm's broad customer base and one-stop offering.
The industrial electric infrared hall heater is well aligned with the firm's main customers in halls and logistics facilities and with the strategic shift toward electrified climate solutions.
The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater directly supports the firm's stated move toward lower-carbon, hydrogen-ready heating and already had a real-operation reference in 2023.
